comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (39.02%) to Turtle beta-defensin 1 C=G=R: 14%. GRAVY: -0.528, mol Wt: 3382.087; mol formula: C147H236N44O36S5; mol ex coeff: 1740. Activity: active against Gram- bacteria P. fluorescens CGMCC 1.3202 (MIC6-12 uM), P. stutzeri CGMCC 1.1803 (MIC 6-12 uM), E. coli CGMCC 1.2385 (MIC 24-48 uM), P. aeruginosa CGMCC 1.2421 (MIC 12-24 uM), A. baumannii CGMCC 1.6769 (MIC 12-24 uM), Gram+ S. aureus CGMCC 1.2465 (MIC 12-24 uM), S. epidermidis CGMCC 1.4260 (MIC 6-12 uM), B. cereus CGMCC 1.3760 (MIC 24-48 uM), E. faecium CGMCC 1.131 (MIC 6-12 uM), E. faecalis CGMCC 1.2135 (MIC 12-24 uM), fungi C. neoformans CGMCC 2.1563 (MIC 6-12 uM), A. niger GMCC 3.316 (MIC 6-12 uM), A. fumigatus CGMCC 3.5835 (MIC 12-24 uM), and N. crassa CGMCC 3.1604 (MIC16-32 uM). F. graminearum CGMCC 3.4521 (MIC 6-12 uM), and F. oxysporum CGMCC 3.6785 (MIC 6-12 uM). MOA:fungi:C. neoformans: permeated fungal membranes. ROS release; DNA fragmentation and apoptosis. Gene Bank: view the deposited mRNA here at NCBI.
title: A Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Sparamosin26-54 From the Mud Crab Scylla paramamosain Showing Potent Antifungal Activity Against Cryptococcus neoformans.
